title: Discounted preservation water rate for habitat restoration
summary: The council passed Committee Report 25-46 on first reading with seven ayes on July 25. The report recommends Bill 56, which would discount water rates for customers who use water to conserve or restore native Hawaiian species habitat. A council member said the Water Department proposed the bill and that the committee supported it unanimously.
